services.name: Eco Tours
services.desc: At Chula Vista Water Sports, we believe that getting out in nature and exploring the beauty around us is one of the best ways to connect with ourselves and our surroundings. Our 2-hour Eco Kayak Tour takes you through the Chula Vista Wetlands, one of the most remote and serene areas of the San Diego Bay. Discover the magic of this hidden gem, accessible only by kayak or paddle board and witness the abundant wildlife that calls this place home. Look closely and you might spot some of the endangered Green sea Turtles and Least Terns. Along the way, you may even catch sight of the stingrays and bat rays swimming below.
